result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days’ written notice, receives a refund of prepaid fees allocable to the post-termination period, and Vendor cannot terminate for convenience during a term. However, allowing termination “in part” goes beyond the playbook and could permit selective service or scope termination, changing commercial economics unnecessarily; it also creates ambiguity regarding allocation of the refund after a partial termination. Otherwise, the clause is professionally drafted.
